name: sso-admin
description: IAM Identity Center is the Amazon Web Services solution for connecting your workforce users to Amazon Web Services managed applications and other Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: add-region
subcommands.description: Adds a Region to an IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: attach-customer-managed-policy-reference-to-permission-set
subcommands.description: Attaches the specified customer managed policy to the specified PermissionSet.

subcommands.name: attach-managed-policy-to-permission-set
subcommands.description: Attaches an Amazon Web Services managed policy ARN to a permission set.

subcommands.name: create-account-assignment
subcommands.description: Assigns access to a principal for a specified Amazon Web Services account using a specified permission set.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates an OAuth 2.0 customer managed application in IAM Identity Center for the given application provider.

subcommands.name: create-application-assignment
subcommands.description: Grant application access to a user or group.

subcommands.name: create-instance
subcommands.description: Creates an instance of IAM Identity Center for a standalone Amazon Web Services account that is not managed by Organizations or a member Amazon Web Services account in an organization.

subcommands.name: create-instance-access-control-attribute-configuration
subcommands.description: Enables the attributes-based access control (ABAC) feature for the specified IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: create-permission-set
subcommands.description: Creates a permission set within a specified IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: create-trusted-token-issuer
subcommands.description: Creates a connection to a trusted token issuer in an instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: delete-account-assignment
subcommands.description: Deletes a principal's access from a specified Amazon Web Services account using a specified permission set.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Deletes the association with the application.

subcommands.name: delete-application-access-scope
subcommands.description: Deletes an IAM Identity Center access scope from an application.

subcommands.name: delete-application-assignment
subcommands.description: Revoke application access to an application by deleting application assignments for a user or group.

subcommands.name: delete-application-authentication-method
subcommands.description: Deletes an authentication method from an application.

subcommands.name: delete-application-grant
subcommands.description: Deletes a grant from an application.

subcommands.name: delete-inline-policy-from-permission-set
subcommands.description: Deletes the inline policy from a specified permission set.

subcommands.name: delete-instance
subcommands.description: Deletes the instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: delete-instance-access-control-attribute-configuration
subcommands.description: Disables the attributes-based access control (ABAC) feature for the specified IAM Identity Center instance and deletes all of the attribute mappings that have been configured.

subcommands.name: delete-permission-set
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified permission set.

subcommands.name: delete-permissions-boundary-from-permission-set
subcommands.description: Deletes the permissions boundary from a specified PermissionSet.

subcommands.name: delete-trusted-token-issuer
subcommands.description: Deletes a trusted token issuer configuration from an instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: describe-account-assignment-creation-status
subcommands.description: Describes the status of the assignment creation request.

subcommands.name: describe-account-assignment-deletion-status
subcommands.description: Describes the status of the assignment deletion request.

subcommands.name: describe-application
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of an application associated with an instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: describe-application-assignment
subcommands.description: Retrieves a direct assignment of a user or group to an application.

subcommands.name: describe-application-provider
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a provider that can be used to connect an Amazon Web Services managed application or customer managed application to IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: describe-instance
subcommands.description: Returns the details of an instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: describe-instance-access-control-attribute-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the list of IAM Identity Center identity store attributes that have been configured to work with attributes-based access control (ABAC) for the specified IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: describe-permission-set
subcommands.description: Gets the details of the permission set.

subcommands.name: describe-permission-set-provisioning-status
subcommands.description: Describes the status for the given permission set provisioning request.

subcommands.name: describe-region
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a specific Region enabled in an IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: describe-trusted-token-issuer
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a trusted token issuer configuration stored in an instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: detach-customer-managed-policy-reference-from-permission-set
subcommands.description: Detaches the specified customer managed policy from the specified PermissionSet.

subcommands.name: detach-managed-policy-from-permission-set
subcommands.description: Detaches the attached Amazon Web Services managed policy ARN from the specified permission set.

subcommands.name: get-application-access-scope
subcommands.description: Retrieves the authorized targets for an IAM Identity Center access scope for an application.

subcommands.name: get-application-assignment-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration of PutApplicationAssignmentConfiguration.

subcommands.name: get-application-authentication-method
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about an authentication method used by an application.

subcommands.name: get-application-grant
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about an application grant.

subcommands.name: get-application-session-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the session configuration for an application in IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: get-inline-policy-for-permission-set
subcommands.description: Obtains the inline policy assigned to the permission set.

subcommands.name: get-permissions-boundary-for-permission-set
subcommands.description: Obtains the permissions boundary for a specified PermissionSet.

subcommands.name: list-account-assignment-creation-status
subcommands.description: Lists the status of the Amazon Web Services account assignment creation requests for a specified IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: list-account-assignment-deletion-status
subcommands.description: Lists the status of the Amazon Web Services account assignment deletion requests for a specified IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: list-account-assignments
subcommands.description: Lists the assignee of the specified Amazon Web Services account with the specified permission set.

subcommands.name: list-account-assignments-for-principal
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the IAM Identity Center associated Amazon Web Services accounts that the principal has access to.

subcommands.name: list-accounts-for-provisioned-permission-set
subcommands.description: Lists all the Amazon Web Services accounts where the specified permission set is provisioned.

subcommands.name: list-application-access-scopes
subcommands.description: Lists the access scopes and authorized targets associated with an application.

subcommands.name: list-application-assignments
subcommands.description: Lists Amazon Web Services account users that are assigned to an application.

subcommands.name: list-application-assignments-for-principal
subcommands.description: Lists the applications to which a specified principal is assigned.

subcommands.name: list-application-authentication-methods
subcommands.description: Lists all of the authentication methods supported by the specified application.

subcommands.name: list-application-grants
subcommands.description: List the grants associated with an application.

subcommands.name: list-application-providers
subcommands.description: Lists the application providers configured in the IAM Identity Center identity store.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Lists all applications associated with the instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: list-customer-managed-policy-references-in-permission-set
subcommands.description: Lists all customer managed policies attached to a specified PermissionSet.

subcommands.name: list-instances
subcommands.description: Lists the details of the organization and account instances of IAM Identity Center that were created in or visible to the account calling this API.

subcommands.name: list-managed-policies-in-permission-set
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Web Services managed policy that is attached to a specified permission set.

subcommands.name: list-permission-set-provisioning-status
subcommands.description: Lists the status of the permission set provisioning requests for a specified IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: list-permission-sets
subcommands.description: Lists the PermissionSets in an IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: list-permission-sets-provisioned-to-account
subcommands.description: Lists all the permission sets that are provisioned to a specified Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-regions
subcommands.description: Lists all enabled Regions of an IAM Identity Center instance, including those that are being added or removed.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to a specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-trusted-token-issuers
subcommands.description: Lists all the trusted token issuers configured in an instance of IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: provision-permission-set
subcommands.description: The process by which a specified permission set is provisioned to the specified target.

subcommands.name: put-application-access-scope
subcommands.description: Adds or updates the list of authorized targets for an IAM Identity Center access scope for an application.

subcommands.name: put-application-assignment-configuration
subcommands.description: Configure how users gain access to an application.

subcommands.name: put-application-authentication-method
subcommands.description: Adds or updates an authentication method for an application.

subcommands.name: put-application-grant
subcommands.description: Creates a configuration for an application to use grants.

subcommands.name: put-application-session-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the session configuration for an application in IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: put-inline-policy-to-permission-set
subcommands.description: Attaches an inline policy to a permission set.

subcommands.name: put-permissions-boundary-to-permission-set
subcommands.description: Attaches an Amazon Web Services managed or customer managed policy to the specified PermissionSet as a permissions boundary.

subcommands.name: remove-region
subcommands.description: Removes an additional Region from an IAM Identity Center instance.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a set of tags with a specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Disassociates a set of tags from a specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates application properties.

subcommands.name: update-instance
subcommands.description: Update the details for the instance of IAM Identity Center that is owned by the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: update-instance-access-control-attribute-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the IAM Identity Center identity store attributes that you can use with the IAM Identity Center instance for attributes-based access control (ABAC).

subcommands.name: update-permission-set
subcommands.description: Updates an existing permission set.

subcommands.name: update-trusted-token-issuer
subcommands.description: Updates the name of the trusted token issuer, or the path of a source attribute or destination attribute for a trusted token issuer configuration.
